description: Create an actor: a persistent AI user persona with its own browser, email inbox (for OTP and magic-link flows), and memory. The description shapes who the persona is, so describe a person (background, goals, tech comfort), not a job title. Call list_actors first and reuse a matching actor; afterwards, add_actor_knowledge gives it context or standards to enforce. Fails when the plan's actor limit is reached.

description.description: Who this persona is: background, goals, and tech comfort, e.g. "Runs a small bakery, shops on her phone, impatient with long forms." Omit to create the actor without one and add it later with update_actor.

kind.description: Whether the actor plays a person ("persona", the default) or an AI agent acting for someone ("agent"). Pick "agent" to test how well an agent can use the product: its checklist runs also read the site's agent files, call its API and the attached MCP servers, and report the gaps they hit. Omit for a persona.

name.description: Display name for the persona, ideally its role rather than a human name, e.g. "First-time visitor" or "Busy finance manager". Also seeds its email inbox address.

workspace_id.description: Workspace UUID, from list_workspaces. Every read and write is scoped to it.

name: create_actor

id.description: The new actor UUID, for get_actor, add_actor_knowledge and runs.

title: Create actor
